title: DebtUpdated.v1
description: Payload of the DebtUpdated event (A§23). Emitted by debt-service — the single producer (A§7.2) — whenever the debt exposure it owns changes (A§5.3, A§9 Debt). Published on `collections.debt` keyed by `debtId` (A§25/§26). Carries the four debt components separately because collections economics, agency commission and write-off decisions are component-sensitive; v1 invariant (SVC-3): every component is non-negative, all components share one `currency`, and `recoverableAmountMinor` equals the sum of the components. Rides the A§24 envelope; a breaking change ships as DebtUpdated.v2 (D§29).

debtId.description: Platform identifier of the debt/exposure. Equal to the envelope `aggregateId` and the Kafka partition key (A§26).

accountId.description: Platform identifier of the account the debt belongs to, so account-scoped consumers (case, payment allocation, agency placement) can join without calling the debt API.

principalMinor.description: Principal component of the exposure, in minor units of `currency` (A§9 DebtComponent). Non-negative.

interestMinor.description: Accrued interest component, in minor units of `currency`. Non-negative.

feesMinor.description: Fees component (arrears fees, servicing fees), in minor units of `currency`. Non-negative.

penaltiesMinor.description: Penalties component (late-payment penalties), in minor units of `currency`. Non-negative.

recoverableAmountMinor.description: Amount considered recoverable, in minor units of `currency`. In v1 this is exactly the sum of principal + interest + fees + penalties (SVC-3 enforces the identity with a property test); it is published explicitly rather than derived so that a future recoverability haircut is a value change, not a consumer-side formula change. Non-negative.

currency.description: ISO-4217 alpha-3 currency of every *Minor amount in this payload. A debt has exactly one currency; components are never mixed.

changedFields.description: Names of the debt fields whose values changed in this update, so consumers can skip work cheaply. debt-service suppresses events for duplicate snapshots (SVC-3), so this array is normally non-empty; an empty array means the debt was republished without a detected change (forced backfill or replay, D§48/§49).
